messages.author: 0c7ffcac30445989
messages.subject: dnegbinom/dnbinom parameterizations
parts:
Hi Nimble Team,

I'm not sure where to submit feature requests—I thought maybe Github but all the people I could see adding comments were members, owners, and/or contributors, so I thought maybe that wasn't an appropriate venue for end-users. Anyhow, if there's a preferred place for submitting dev requests, please let me know.

I'd like to use an alternate parameterization of dnbinom, one where the 'mean (mu)' and 'size' are specified in the function call rather than the standard 'size' and 'prob' parameters. R supports this paramterization, but Nimble doesn't. I'm about to look into writing my own functions, but figured I'd submit a feature request as well.

Thanks again!

Chris

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: dnegbinom/dnbinom parameterizations
parts:
Hi Chris,

Thanks for the suggestion.

Yes it is fine to use GitHub for an issue or feature request.

For your immediate needs, yes writing your own distribution would be a good solution.

Here is another option:  The built-in distributions are all defined fairly neatly in a master list in the source file distributions_inputList.R.  You can see there examples of how alternative parameterizations are defined if it is possible to do so with simple expressions relating one parameterization to another (in the list element altParams of each entry).  You can look at dnorm or dbeta for examples, and then try modifying the entry to dnegbin by providing an altParams entry for your needs.

-Perry
